program:
PARAMS = {
    "L_n":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.4),      # inverter nfet length [um]
    "L_p":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.4),      # inverter pfet length [um]
    "vx_t":     (0.17, 0.08, 0.32),     # target source-node voltage of inverter nfet [V]
    "kp":       (1.0, 0.7, 1.4),        # pfet width trim (sets virtual-ground DC)
    "R1":       (5.0e5, 1.0e5, 2.0e6),
    "cf_ratio": (3.0, 1.5, 8.0),        # Cf_total / gate-node cap
    "Lt":       (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # mirror length (ref + tail) [um]
    "Wr":       (6.0, 3.0, 12.0),       # reference diode width [um]
    "ratio":    (6.2, 4.0, 6.6),        # tail/ref current ratio
    "Cx":       (6e-12, 2e-12, 15e-12), # decap at nfet source node
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd, vcm = 1.8, 0.9
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.5e-12)
    Ln, Lp, Lt, Wr = p["L_n"], p["L_p"], p["Lt"], p["Wr"]
    Wt = Wr * p["ratio"]
    it0 = p["ratio"] * iref
    vx0 = p["vx_t"]

    def find_w(dev, L, I, vg, vd, vsb=0.0):
        W = 10.0
        for _ in range(3):
            W = W * I / lut.op(dev, W, L, vg, vd, vsb)["Id"]
        return W

    # reference diode Vgs
    lo, hi = 0.3, 1.5
    for _ in range(40):
        m = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op("n", Wr, Lt, m, m)["Id"] < iref:
            lo = m
        else:
            hi = m
    vgr = 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    Wn = max(0.42, find_w("n", Ln, it0, vcm - vx0, vcm - vx0, vx0))
    Wp = max(0.42, p["kp"] * find_w("p", Lp, it0, vdd - vcm, vdd - vcm))

    def solve_vx(vg):
        # MN current (falls with vx) = tail current (rises with vx)
        a, b = 0.005, max(vg - 0.1, 0.02)
        for _ in range(30):
            v = 0.5 * (a + b)
            In = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vg - v, vcm - v, v)["Id"]
            It = lut.op("n", Wt, Lt, vgr, v)["Id"]
            if In > It:
                a = v
            else:
                b = v
        v = 0.5 * (a + b)
        return v, lut.op("n", Wt, Lt, vgr, v)["Id"]

    # virtual-ground DC: pfet current (at vout~0.9) equals tail current
    a, b = 0.6, 1.2
    for _ in range(30):
        vg = 0.5 * (a + b)
        vx, it = solve_vx(vg)
        ip = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vdd - vg, vdd - vcm)["Id"]
        if ip > it:
            a = vg
        else:
            b = vg
    vg = 0.5 * (a + b)
    vx, itail = solve_vx(vg)

    opn = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vg - vx, vcm - vx, vx)
    opp = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vdd - vg, vdd - vcm)
    opt = lut.op("n", Wt, Lt, vgr, vx)
    gm_hf = opn["gm"] + opp["gm"]
    gds_hf = opn["gds"] + opp["gds"]
    # DC: nfet branch degenerated by tail -> high impedance, only pfet gm
    rn_dc = (1.0 / opn["gds"]) * (1 + opn["gm"] / max(opt["gds"], 1e-9))
    gds_dc = opp["gds"] + 1.0 / rn_dc
    gm_dc = opp["gm"]

    cgd_est = 0.25e-15 * (Wn + Wp)
    cdd_est = 0.5e-15 * (Wn + Wp)
    cgg = opn["cgg"] + opp["cgg"]
    cnode = max(cgg - cgd_est, 0.5 * cgg) + 5e-15

    R1 = p["R1"]
    g1t, g2t = 0.15709, 0.01797
    Rf, R2 = g1t * R1, g1t * R1 / g2t
    corr, beta, A = 1.0, 0.85, 10.0
    for _ in range(10):
        Gl = 1.0 / (Rf + 1.0 / (1.0 / R1 + 1.0 / R2))
        A = gm_dc / (gds_dc + Gl)
        beta = (1 / Rf) / (1 / Rf + 1 / R1 + 1 / R2)
        corr = A * beta / (1 + A * beta)
        Rf = g1t * R1 / corr
        R2 = Rf * corr / g2t
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * corr
    a2 = -(Rf / R2) * corr

    Cf_tot = p["cf_ratio"] * cnode
    Cf = max(Cf_tot - cgd_est, 1e-15)
    tau = Rf * Cf_tot
    C1, C2 = tau / R1, tau / R2
    csum = C1 + C2 + cnode
    beta_hf = Cf_tot / (Cf_tot + csum)
    cout = cl + Cf_tot * csum / (Cf_tot + csum) + cdd_est
    kfit = 0.63   # empirical sim/model factor from previous iteration
    bw = kfit * gm_hf * beta_hf / (2 * PI * cout)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wr, Lt)
    n.M("MT", "nx", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lt)
    n.C("CX", "nx", "vss", p["Cx"])
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vinn", "nx", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vinn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RI1", "vin1", "vinn", R1)
    n.R("RI2", "vin2", "vinn", R2)
    n.R("RF", "vinn", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CI1", "vin1", "vinn", C1)
    n.C("CI2", "vin2", "vinn", C2)
    n.C("CF", "vinn", "vout", Cf)
    n.C("CDUM", "vcm", "vss", 1e-15)

    off = (vg - vcm) * A / (1 + A * beta)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": a2, "bw": bw,
               "vout_offset": off,
               "power": vdd * (iref + itail)}
